MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The caliper felt like a useful next purchase because it would help me measure and match parts for my washer and bolt assortments.",
    "The magnets and caster wheels connected to my recent interest in magnetic hooks and moving equipment, even though I do not need those particular items now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Plain disc magnets share a material with my magnetic hooks, but they do not provide the hanging function I recently needed.",
    "Resistors, heat shrink tubing, wire connectors and filament assume electronics or printing projects that my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "Gloves, an ultrasonic cleaner and glue do not address an immediate task I have, so general usefulness would not make me choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying fastener assortments seemed to be taken as interest in supplies for almost any workshop project.",
    "Shared materials or broad uses seemed to matter too much: magnets are not interchangeable with magnetic hooks, and caster wheels are not an automatic next purchase after a hand truck."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases point most clearly toward fastening, hanging and matching mechanical parts; the caliper supports those specific tasks.",
    "I rarely choose something without a current use for it, even when it relates to equipment I already own.",
    "My two recent magnetic-hook purchases make the hook function more relevant than magnet strength alone."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my practical hardware interests but stretched them into unrelated projects instead of focusing on tools that support my current fastening and hanging tasks."
}
